summary.text: Mary-Katherine Stone, a Democrat from Burlington, has represented Chittenden-14 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2023.
She sits on the House Committee on Government Operations and Military Affairs.

paragraphs.text: Stone earned a BA in interdisciplinary studies from the University of Alabama's New College program and an MS in occupational therapy from the University of Alabama at Birmingham, according to her House biography.
She has been an elected Justice of the Peace since 2020 and works as an occupational therapist and substitute teacher in her local public schools.
She holds positions on the boards of the Vermont Student Assistance Corporation and Leadership Champlain.
In the House she co-chairs the Vermont Future Caucus and the National Guard and Military Affairs Caucus, and in 2024 she was appointed to the NCSL Military and Veterans Affairs Task Force.
She lives in Burlington with her husband, Ryan, an Air Force Reserve pilot.
